definitions.name: N
definitions.source_text: let N[p in patch] = S[p] + E[p] + I[p] + R[p]

transitions.name: infection
transitions.source_text:
infection[p in patch] : S[p] --> E[p]
    @ overdispersed(beta * seas * S[p] * (I[p] + iota) / N[p], sigma_se)

transitions.name: importation
transitions.source_text:
importation[p in patch, q in patch] : S[p] --> E[p]
    @ kappa * W[p, q] * S[p] * I[q] / N[q] where p != q

transitions.name: progression
transitions.source_text: progression[p in patch] : E[p] --> I[p]  @ sigma * E[p]

transitions.name: recovery
transitions.source_text: recovery[p in patch]    : I[p] --> R[p]  @ gamma * I[p]

transitions.name: waning
transitions.source_text: waning[p in patch]      : R[p] --> S[p]  @ waning_rate * R[p]

scenarios.source_text:
true_params {
    label = "true parameter values for PGAS density round-trip"
    set = {
      R0        = 20.0
      sigma     = 0.125
      gamma     = 0.2
      kappa     = 0.05
      amplitude = 0.3
      iota      = 1e-6
      rho       = 0.4
      sigma_se  = 0.05
      N0_p1     = 100000
      N0_p2     = 80000
      N0_p3     = 60000
      N0_p4     = 50000
      N0_p5     = 150000
      k         = 10.0
    }
  }
